dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So apparently, some detectives in Fontaine manage to solve cases without ever setting foot outside their homes. They call them "armchair detectives"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's what they call "working from home," right? Sounds pretty cushy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, how do they figure out the truth if they never even go to the crime scene? ...Oh, Paimon knows! They must be using divination.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're thinking of fortune-tellers, Paimon. Not detectives.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean... Oh, the detective must have people collecting information for them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? But... that would mean the detective gets all the credit for our hard work! Bet they make a tidy sum of Mora off of it, too! Hmph, Paimon won't stand for that. Let's go have a little talk with Detective Armchair right now!

choices.text: Maybe they post commissions at the Adventurers Guild?
Surely the evidence isn't just dropping itself off at the detective's doorstep.
